transformerpalettes

Source: CLAUDE.md

R package of color palettes drawn from the Transformers franchise (Generation 1 toys, their Generation 2 re-releases, the cartoon and the Marvel comics), built on the same pattern as the sibling package glyospalettes (same author, Glyos colorways; formerly rglyos). Fan project; hex values are hand-curated approximations.

Where things live

  • R/aaa-registry.R: the single source of truth. Every toy palette is a leader() / member() / combined() call with colors and metadata; cartoon and comic versions are cartoon() / comic() calls further down that inherit the toy entry. tf_palettes and tf_characters are derived from it in R/palettes.R. Every function takes medium (default "toy").
  • R/usecase.R: perceptual stats and the categorical / colorblind / sequential / diverging shortlists. Shared logic with glyospalettes; keep in sync.
  • vignettes/articles/browse.Rmd: the filterable browser on the pkgdown site. It serialises tf_characters + stats to JSON and renders cards with “Suggest a change” links that prefill .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml.
  • WISHLIST.md: the queue of characters to add and corrections to check. This is the intended way to extend the package: the user edits the wishlist, then asks for a pass over it.
  • data-raw/README.md: how a palette is made and the conventions an entry follows. data-raw/make_figures.R regenerates man/figures/.

Working through the wishlist

When asked to add characters (or with no other instruction, when WISHLIST.md has unchecked lines under Queued):

  1. Take queued lines in order, high priority first. For each character, fetch its Transformers Wiki page (https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Name_(G1); some large characters have a /toys subpage) to confirm the page exists, the original toy’s release year, its alternate mode, and the URL of the toy photo (https://tfwiki.net/mediawiki/images2/<a>/<ab>/<File>.jpg; strip the thumb/ and size prefix). Direct curl to tfwiki.net gets a 403; use the WebFetch tool. The wiki’s fast summaries are unreliable about colors; rely on the toy photo, the wiki’s prose about the toy, and knowledge of the toy. Leave image as NA rather than guessing a URL.
  2. Add entries to R/aaa-registry.R in a new or existing block, following the conventions in WISHLIST.md (order, naming, 4-6 colors, body color first). New teams go in .team_faction and the .registry_toys vector. New roles or subgroups may need tf_characters docs and tests updated. Add a cartoon() entry for every new toy entry (tests require it), with an episode still as the image: list the episode-named image filenames on the wiki page with WebFetch, compute the MediaWiki hash path (see data-raw/README.md) and verify it with curl -A "Mozilla/5.0 ...". Comic entries are optional; when adding one, name the Marvel issue the colors were sampled from in the description.
  3. Run Rscript -e "devtools::document()", Rscript -e "devtools::test()", Rscript data-raw/make_figures.R. Fix anything that fails.
  4. Move the wishlist line to Done with the next version number, update the Coverage table in README.md, add a NEWS.md bullet, bump Version in DESCRIPTION if this is a release.
  5. Rebuild the site locally to check the browser renders the new cards: Rscript -e "pkgdown::build_site()", then open docs/articles/browse.html (the .claude/launch.json config pkgdown-site serves docs/).

Do not commit or push unless asked. Keep the package free of non-ASCII characters in R code and Rd (CRAN check), including in descriptions.

Release checks

dev/release_checks.R is the pre-CRAN checklist (not shipped; dev is in .Rbuildignore). Source it section by section: document, figures, site, tests, devtools::check(cran = TRUE, incoming = TRUE, remote = TRUE), urlchecker::url_check(), spelling::spell_check_package() against inst/WORDLIST, tarball size, then win-builder. cran-comments.md holds the notes for the reviewer; update its check results before submitting. When a wishlist pass adds new names, run spelling::update_wordlist() after confirming the only new words are character, team or company names.

Commands

Rscript -e "devtools::document()"
Rscript -e "devtools::test()"
Rscript -e "devtools::check()"
Rscript data-raw/make_figures.R
Rscript -e "pkgdown::build_site()"
Rscript -e "spelling::spell_check_package()"
Rscript -e "urlchecker::url_check()"
